summary: ini inventory rules: quote strings, `:vars` values are always strings (`var=FALSE` is a string), host lines take several key=value pairs with quoted spaces, prefer YAML for types, and double-quote values with `#`, `{` or `}` like `pg_password='"mypasswordwith#hashsigns"'`.
questions: My password has a # in the inventory file
Why is my boolean a string in an ini inventory?
How do I escape special characters in AAP inventory?

answer_card.title: Special characters in inventory values
answer_card.answer_md:
Wrap the value in both single and double quotes:
```ini
pg_password='"mypasswordwith#hashsigns"'
```
Also remember that in `ini` `:vars` sections every value is a string (`var=FALSE` is the string "FALSE"); use YAML inventories if types matter.
